data.bottom_line: An incoming storm will develop dangerous avalanche conditions throughout the day on Saturday. The most dangerous slopes face northwest through north to east near and above treeline. In some areas, you can trigger a large, dangerous avalanche from a distance, so be aware of steep slopes above you and other parties nearby. The most dangerous slopes are the leeward sides of a ridgeline, where westerly winds drift additional snow. The easiest way to find safer travel options is to stick to lower elevations below treeline or avoid traveling on or under consequential slopes steeper than about 30 degrees on aspects of concern at upper elevations.
